title: LiveCanvas one-pager — client review email draft receipt
description: Written by Stage 5 to outputs/email-to-client__draft-receipt.json after the Gmail draft is created. Carries ids and gate evidence only — never the email body, never a credential, never the recipient's address in clear.

recipient_sha256.description: sha256 of the lowercased recipient address; the address itself stays in client.json

draft_file.description: repo-relative path of the pre-edit draft markdown

sent_by_framework.description: Always false: the framework never sends

operator_edits_note.description: repo-relative path of the sanitized operator-edits note, if the operator supplied the sent text
